title: Étale origin of constructible complexes locally of finite Tor dimension
statement:
Let $X$ be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated scheme [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme, def-weil-quasi-separated-morphism], and let $A$ be a discrete commutative Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring]. Use the small étale and pro-étale sites [def-weil-pbc-etale-site, def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], constant coefficient sheaves $A_X$ [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf], categories of module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] and their unbounded derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Write $\nu_X:X_{\mathrm{proét}}\to X_{\mathrm{ét}}$ for the comparison morphism [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism] and $\nu_X^*$ for its inverse image on module sheaves, which is exact [det-pe-classical-sheaves-modules] and is applied termwise on derived categories.

For $M\in D(X_{\mathrm{proét}},A_X)$, the following are equivalent:

1. Every $H^q(M)$ is constructible [def-sfb-affine-locally-constructible-proetale-modules], and $M$ locally has finite Tor dimension: for every site object $U$ there is a covering $\{U_i\to U\}$ and integers $a_i\leq b_i$ such that $H^q(M|_{U_i}\otimes^L_{A_X|_{U_i}}N_i)=0$ for every degree-zero module sheaf $N_i$ on the slice and every $q\notin[a_i,b_i]$. Slice restriction is [def-weil-pbc-ringed-derived-restriction, def-pur-localized-ringed-site], and tensor and cohomology are [sk-def-sfb-derived-tensor-hom, def-weil-derived-cohomology-sheaves].
2. There are a bounded constructible complex $C\in D^b_c(X_{\mathrm{ét}},A)$ [def-pe-etale-constructible-module] and an isomorphism $\nu_X^*C\simeq M$, with $C$ of finite Tor amplitude: there exist integers $a\leq b$ such that $H^q(C\otimes^L_{A_X}N)=0$ for every degree-zero étale $A_X$-module sheaf $N$ and every $q\notin[a,b]$.

No boundedness, completeness, or prior étale-origin assumption is imposed on $M$.

source.place: Tag 09C2, lemma-describe-constructible-complexes, parts (2) and (4) for n=1 and their proof (the uniform Tor interval on quasi-compact X, and étale origin via Tag 09AL, lemma-compare-constructible-derived, with the 'small argument omitted' that the étale antecedent keeps the Tor interval); the converse direction from Tag 09AL and the Noetherian interval comparison.
